decision.summary: Only one candidate temporary offset identified: a broad E-component platform from index 495 to 535 with gradual onset, sustained interior, and incomplete/ambiguous return. No confirmed opposing return observed before index 580; N/U lack coherent supporting evidence. No other temporary offsets meet criteria within allowed context.

intervals.observation: E-component shows a broad, asymmetric platform-like rise from ~495 to ~520 followed by slower decay to ~535; no clean opposing return observed within allowed context (460–580). N and U show weaker, incoherent co-variation. Shape inconsistent with noise but lacks confirmed reversal; status uncertain.
